name: Research a spike
description: Answers one spike ticket from the scratch directory by research alone (docs, code, issues, the web), without changing any files, and writes <ticket>_REPORT.md. Runs without asking you anything.

parameters.label: Ticket
parameters.description: The spike's id: its file name in the scratch directory without .md, e.g. spike-002-cache-library.

parameters.label: The document it serves
parameters.description: The file in the scratch directory the spike settles a question for, e.g. SPECS.md (the draft specs) or OPTIONS.md (architecture options).

steps.name: Research the spike
steps.prompt:
Research spike {{params.ticket}} of {{ticket.title}}.

Read the spike, {{scratch.path}}/{{params.ticket}}.md, and the draft it serves, {{scratch.path}}/{{params.brief}}. Answer its question by reading: the repo's docs and code, the docs of any library or service involved, issues and the web. Do not change any files.

Reply with the report, in markdown, and nothing else:

# Report: {{params.ticket}}
## Question
## Answer
(short and direct; say how sure you are)
## Evidence
(each source, with what it showed)
## What it means for {{params.brief}}
## Still unknown
